name: XR Guild

void.role: Deepest ground. Full-bleed dark surfaces, favicon backgrounds.

indigo.role: Primary brand ground. The colour people should remember.

panel.role: Raised panel on indigo. Cards, quote blocks, table headers.

white.role: Headlines and primary text on dark.

silver.role: Body text on dark. Rules and dividers at 20% opacity.

muted.role: Captions and metadata only. Never body text.

cyan.role: Signal. One use per surface: the action, the date, or the mark.

paper.role: Light ground for documents, invoices, and print.

display.use: Headlines, the wordmark, numbers that matter.

text.use: Everything a person reads to understand or act.

detail.use: Dates, times, addresses, invoice numbers, labels.
